agency.name: Georgia Department of Revenue, Motor Vehicle Division

gaps: On a used car, TAVT is due on the value in the state motor vehicle assessment manual (average of wholesale and retail), not on the price paid; the engine uses the price and says so.
On a new car, TAVT is due on the greater of the selling price and the manual value; the engine uses the selling price.
Emissions test prices are set by the testing stations; the Clean Air Force pages read do not state a fee, so the test is shown without an amount.
Plug-in hybrids pay the alternative fuel fee only if the owner chooses an alternative fuel plate; the engine leaves it out and says so.

summary.docFeeNote: Georgia does not regulate the amount of dealer fees, but they must be included in any advertised price (Georgia Attorney General).
summary.inspectionWhere: Yearly emissions test in 13 metro Atlanta counties for gasoline cars and light trucks except the three newest model years and those 25 model years or older; no safety inspection.

singular: Georgia has no sales tax on cars: since March 1, 2013 a one-time title ad valorem tax (TAVT) replaces both the sales tax and the yearly tax on the car's value [tavt].
TAVT is 7.0% of the fair market value, and that value comes from the state assessment manual, not only from the price on the bill of sale [faq].
A dealer trade-in reduces the TAVT base; a trade-in between private individuals does not [faq].
New residents pay TAVT at 3% when they bring a car already titled in their name, and family transfers can pay 0.5% [tavt].
The yearly plate fee for an ordinary car is only $20, among the lowest in the country, and the title costs $18 [fees].
Fully electric cars pay a yearly alternative fuel fee, indexed every July: $238.59 for registrations from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027 [afv].
Thirteen counties around Atlanta require a yearly emissions test, but the three newest model years are exempt (2024 and newer for 2026) [caf].
Georgia does not cap dealer fees; the Attorney General requires them to be included in the advertised price [doc-fee].

tavt.name: Georgia DOR, Vehicle Taxes: Title Ad Valorem Tax (TAVT) and Annual Ad Valorem Tax
tavt.quote: The current TAVT rate is 7.0% of the fair market value of the vehicle. ... It replaced sales tax and annual ad valorem tax

faq.name: Georgia DOR, Title Ad Valorem Tax (TAVT) FAQ
faq.quote: For a used motor vehicle, the fair market value is the value identified in the state motor vehicle assessment manual ... A reduction is made for the trade-in when the sale was made by a dealer, but not when the sale was made by a private individual.

caf.name: Georgia's Clean Air Force, Frequently Asked Questions
caf.quote: For registration in 2026, the three most recent model years are exempt from emissions testing, which includes 2024 or newer model year vehicles.

doc-fee.name: Georgia Attorney General, Consumer Protection Division: maximum dealer doc fee
doc-fee.quote: Georgia does not regulate how much a car dealer can charge in dealer fees, also frequently referred to as “document fees”
